### 1. What the caller expresses, and simulator mode

- Target object: "your Cash Rewards Visa, the card ending in 7318"; action: "you want to use my cash back to pay down my card balance, right now on this call, and if it happens to cover the whole balance, even better". Timing: now. Authorisation: "You are glad to approve or click through anything the agent sends you yourself".
- The caller does not know the balance or the points ("they will have to look that up") and never mentions the late fee or the checking account.
- The simulator is passive and conditional: it consents to a checking deposit only "If the agent tells you your checking account is overdrawn and that the points have to go there first", names the account only "if they ask which account" (Everyday Checking ending 6092), accepts a fee correction only "If the agent mentions that a fee on the card is being taken off or corrected", runs whatever it is handed, declines onward routing of leftover points and any autopay change. It never initiates the checking deposit or the fee reversal.
- Identity: phone 3365550166, DOB 1987-03-19, SSN4 6427 → `verify_customer_identity` returned "Identity verified … (3 detail(s) matched this attempt)".

### 4. Scored parameters — formula in words, inputs, intermediates, final value

A. Late fee reversal (`reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c`, agent):
- Recent unreversed late fee: fees posted less than one whole calendar month before 2026-09-15 = 1 (2026-09-12); reversals in that period = 0; remainder 1 → present (late_fee_under_examination).
- Instruction reaches the minimum: `statement_balance` → "yes" (autopay_instruction_sufficiency table).
- Funding account: cardholder's own PCB checking, `active`, negative-since 2026-09-13 falls after due date 2026-09-11 → "counts as funded on the due date" (autopay_funding_account_condition; its table row "active | 21 June | yes, it went negative only after the due date").
- Payment record: payments dated 2026-09-11 = 0 → met (due_date_payment_record).
- All requirements met → "bank error", courtesy allowance not consulted (autopay_miss_ground_determination truth table row 1).
- Amount: whole fee, 32.00 ("The reversal always takes back the whole fee, never part of it").
- Parameters: customer_id 7b65ca78-f68c-4652-b5db-c857180c5e56; card_account_id d5ece847…; source_item_id 7531336e-b083-48a3-b453-170d908e9804; amount 32.00; adjustment_reason bank_error. Observed receipt: status reversed, statement_cycle 2026-09, new_current_balance 244.42.

B. Restoring deposit (`restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef`, user):
- Deficit = negative ledger balance of the autopay-source checking stated positive = 64.18 (overdrawn_source_shortfall).
- Points needed = 64.18 / 0.01 = 6418 exactly (shortfall_points_conversion: "A division that comes out at an exact whole number of points is used as it stands"). (Note: naive binary floating point gives 6418.000000000001 → ceil 6419; that is an arithmetic trap, not a KB statement.)
- Points available on the card from the ledger = 32203 − 0 − 750 = 31453 (restoration_points_available); ≥ tier minimum 2500.
- Points redeemed = max(6418, 2500) = 6418; 31453 ≥ 6418 so not capped (restoration_redemption_size).
- Cash = 6418 × 0.01 = 64.18.
- Parameters: card_account_id d5ece847…; checking_account_id df4449dd…; reward_points 6418; amount 64.18. Observed receipt: redeemed, new_rewards_balance 25035.

C. Points statement credit (`apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528`, user):
- Amount owed on which to size: current amount owed 276.42 contains the 32.00 fee whose proper ground is bank error, which "is not owed"; after the reversal the card shows 244.42 (payoff_balance_and_covering_points).
- Covering points = 244.42 / 0.01 = 24442 exactly.
- Pool = ledger count after the other required redemption = 31453 − 6418 = 25035 (payoff_points_pool).
- Active PCB checking held (df4449dd status active) → points applied = min(25035, 24442) = 24442 (payoff_checking_relationship).
- 24442 ≥ 2500 and card owes > 0 → credit made; value 24442 × 0.01 = 244.42 (payoff_credit_threshold).
- Parameters: card_account_id d5ece847…; reward_points 24442; amount 244.42. Observed receipt: credited, new_rewards_balance 593, new_current_balance 0.0.

No autopay change (caller: "leave it the way it is"; no visible rule requires one). Leftover 593 points stay on the card (caller: "leave whatever is left on the card").

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root problem P0 (asked): redeem points as a statement credit against the card's balance.

Hop H1 — P0 depends on P1 "the recent late fee must come off on the bank error ground" (P1 → P0). **derived** (with a note).
- Blocked-side principle (payoff_balance_and_covering_points): "That figure stands only for sums the cardholder genuinely owes under this charter. A charge billed in breach of the charter, the kind whose proper ground of reversal is bank error, is not owed; an amount owed that still contains such a charge is not a figure on which the credit can properly be sized."
- Record: `find_card_transactions` shows `card_fee` 32.0 `fee_code` late_payment posted 2026-09-12; card autopay statement_balance from df4449dd.
- Findability by the records' own words: `KB_search("late payment fee autopay")` returns late_fee_under_examination, fee_reversals, autopay_miss_ground_determination.
- Depended-on rules: autopay_miss_ground_determination ("A recent late payment fee still standing on the card is a fee the bank billed contrary to the card charter, to be taken back in full on the bank error ground, only when … each requirement … is satisfied"), with the four requirement docs (item 4A) all met on the records → the fee "is a charge billed in breach of the charter" → it is not owed → the credit cannot be sized on 276.42 → the fee comes off first.
- Note: the payoff document states the principle in abstract terms (a class of charge), naming neither late fees nor autopay nor any action; which charge qualifies, and that it qualifies, needs five further documents plus three records. The sentence does, however, carry a sizing gate ("not a figure on which the credit can properly be sized") — flagged for the implicitness scan.

Hop H2 — P0 depends on P2 "restoring deposit of points into the overdrawn autopay checking" (P2 → P0). **read off (order), derived (identity)**.
- Blocked-side sentence (payoff_points_pool): "The pool a statement credit draws on is the card's points net of every other redemption that this charter requires in the same circumstance, that is, on a cardholder's request to spend points against the card's debt. Points that the charter sends somewhere else in that circumstance never form part of the pool, and the count is taken from the ledger once no such redemption remains outstanding." This single sentence states outright that some other redemption may be required on a payoff request and that the count waits until it is no longer outstanding — a gating clause in abstract wording.
- Depended-on rule (autopay_source_restoration_redemption): "It applies when a cardholder seeks to put rewards points toward what a card owes at a time when the PCB checking account the card relies on as its autopay source is overdrawn. In that situation, the card's points are redeemed into that account as a deposit, in the number it takes to lift it to zero, since an account below zero cannot fund the automatic payment that pays the card." — this states P2's trigger in the exact terms of the root request.
- Records: card `autopay_source_account_id` df4449dd; that account `ledger_balance` -64.18.
- Findability: `KB_search("checking account overdrawn autopay rewards")` → restoration doc first; also `KB_search("use cash back rewards to pay down credit card balance")` lists the restoration doc 5th.
- Which redemption is "required in the same circumstance" is identified only by combining the pool sentence with the restoration trigger and the two records; the order itself is read off the pool sentence.

Hop H3 — within P1, the four requirement tests (instruction, funding account, due-date payments, recent fee) are each **derived** from their own definitional docs plus records; no document tells the solver to run them for a points payoff.

Hop H4 — within P2, size = max(points needed, 2500) capped at points held: **derived** from overdrawn_source_shortfall + shortfall_points_conversion + restoration_redemption_size + restoration_points_available.

No further hop: after P1 and P2 nothing else visible bears on P0 (courtesy allowance irrelevant under bank error; autopay change not required; checking ledger posting explicitly not awaited).

Handling order: {P1, P2} in either order, then P0.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Visible materials fully support the conclusion: every figure above is computed only from quoted KB rules and tool returns; the three tool calls succeeded in the rollout world with the receipts quoted.
- Closest alternatives and what excludes them:
  - Credit of 27642 points / 276.42 on the balance as shown: excluded by payoff_balance_and_covering_points ("an amount owed that still contains such a charge is not a figure on which the credit can properly be sized") + the autopay bank-error determination.
  - Fee reversed as courtesy_waiver: excluded by autopay_miss_ground_determination ("The cardholder's courtesy allowance is then neither used up nor looked at") and autopay_late_fee_reversal_ground ("the fee comes off on the bank error ground and the cardholder's courtesy allowance plays no part at all").
  - Fee not reversible because the minimum was genuinely unpaid (late_and_returned_payment_fees: a late fee "arises when everything paid … falls short"): the autopay-miss rule supplies the ground specifically when the bank failed to take the debit; the records meet every requirement.
  - Funding account "overdrawn" so requirement failed: excluded by autopay_funding_account_condition ("An account that is overdrawn today but whose negative stretch began after the due date was still funded on the due date").
  - Restoring 2500 (the minimum) or 6419 points: excluded by restoration_redemption_size (larger of needed and minimum) and shortfall_points_conversion (exact whole number used as it stands).
  - Pool counted before the restoration (31453): excluded by payoff_points_pool; in this world it would not change the applied figure (min(31453, 24442) = 24442), so only the order is at stake.
  - Applying every point (31453): excluded by payoff_checking_relationship (active PCB checking held → smaller of pool and covering points).
- "Do only the one thing asked" (credit 276.42 straight away): leaves the credit sized on an amount containing a charge that "is not owed" (payoff_balance_and_covering_points), and spends points from a pool that is required to be "net of every other redemption that this charter requires in the same circumstance" while the autopay source stands at -64.18 (payoff_points_pool + autopay_source_restoration_redemption). Both exclusions rest on visible principles and records; the second is excluded in part because a single sentence states the gate (see H2).
